The government's nutrition guidance was broken.

For decades, Washington promoted low-quality, highly processed foods over whole, nutrient-dense foods. The results speak for themselves: nearly 90% of health care spending goes to treating chronic disease, much of it driven by diet.

The new Dietary Guidelines for Americans, released under Secretary Kennedy's leadership, get it right: Real protein. Healthy fats. Whole foods. Real nutrition.

This is what happens when government follows the science
